subject: Next steps & locking a 30m demo — proposed windows and infra asks
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & locking a 30m demo — proposed windows and infra asks

Thanks again for your time today, Emma — really helpful context on your ingestion patterns and the audit requirements for downstream clinical apps. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the right follow-up: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for near-realtime clinical suggestions at point-of-care.
- Expected burst pattern: ~250 qps peak for 10–15 min windows, mostly short sequences.
- Security: must be SOC2-aligned; your team needs audit logs and retention controls.

Proposed next step: 30-minute product intro + quick ops/infra readout (we'll keep it focused). Can you confirm one of these 30-minute windows? I tried to pick times that leave room for your infra/security attendees: 
- Option A: Thu 10 Jul, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Thu 10 Jul, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Option C: Fri 11 Jul, 08:30–09:00 PT

Ask from our side before demo:
1) Please confirm which two stakeholders will join (one product/clinical owner + one infra/security lead) so we can tailor the ops portion.
2) Any constraints around VPN/access for a short infra demo (we can run everything over screenshare, but we need to know if any internal firewall rules might block our agent demo).

I attached a short discovery recap and a lightweight demo deck to orient attendees. If those windows don't work, tell us two 30-minute brackets that do and we'll accommodate.

If helpful, Priyom can propose technical deep-dive slots (45–60 min) after this intro — tagging him here.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment: discovery-recap-20250709.pdf (summary, contact map)
Attachment: redwood-30m-demo-deck.pdf (30-min agenda + slides)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@stratushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stratushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & locking a 30m demo — proposed windows and infra asks

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear recap. We liked the focused scope. Quick answers:
- Attendees: I'll invite Rajiv (infra/security) and Maya Chen (clinical lead).
- Availability: Option B (Thu 10 Jul, 15:00 PT) works best for Rajiv and Maya. Option C could work as a backup.
- VPN/firewall: Rajiv flagged that we can't allow inbound demo agents into the env; screenshare is preferred. He also asked whether you can share SOC2 artifacts (summary) and a short list of the telemetry/log types Redwood produces.

Please book Option B and include any calendar dial-in + a short agenda for the 30 minutes. We'll aim to have the two attendees present.

Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, StratusHealth
emma.li@stratushealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@stratushealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 07:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & locking a 30m demo — proposed windows and infra asks

Thanks Emma — locking Thu 10 Jul, 15:00 PT for the 30-min intro. I'll coordinate the calendar invite (will send in a minute).

For the ops portion, quick notes so we can make the 30 minutes actionable:
- We'll split the 30m: 18m product walkthrough (focus on latency/cost levers), 10m infra and logging, 2m next steps.
- For the infra demo we'll use screen share only (no inbound agents). We'll show: runtime topology, how routing/fallback works, and the audit/logging UI for request traces and retention controls.
- SOC2: I can share our SOC2 summary and a redacted auditor letter in advance. I'll put the artifacts in the drive link Grace included.
- If Rajiv wants a deeper run (kernel selection, quantization tradeoffs), I'd recommend a follow-up 60-min tech deep dive — Thursday afternoon next week is open for me.

I'll attach a brief agenda and the drive link in the invite.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-30m-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks — invite received and accepted (Thu 10 Jul, 15:00–15:30 PT).

A couple quick items ahead of the call:
- Please drop the SOC2 summary + list of telemetry columns you record (request id, model, latency, requester, payload size, retention TTL) into the Drive link so Rajiv can pre-check.
- For the agenda, please call out who will speak for each section (product, infra, Q&A).

Looking forward to it.
Emma
